questions.q: Both inputs A and B are 1. Which of these gates gives output 0?
questions.why: XOR gives 1 only when the inputs differ, so 1 XOR 1 = 0; AND and OR both give 1.

questions.q: How many rows does a truth table with three inputs have?
What is the output of X = (A OR B) AND (NOT C) when A = 0, B = 1 and C = 0?
questions.why: A OR B = 1, NOT C = 1, 1 AND 1 = 1.
